dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: I'm the ship's craftsman. I'm responsible for ship repairs and maintenance.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: When there's no work to do, I'll carry out new research on such questions as how to expand a ship's cabin capacity without compromising the structural integrity of its hull...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: But in the end, I'm no researcher. I don't have a lot of theoretical knowledge, no means to conduct experiments, and I have no friends who study in Kshahrewar, and now that Akasha has been shut down...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: But Qishan says that this may not be a bad thing. Now that the Akasha Terminals are gone, she says, everyone is free to obtain whatever knowledge they desire.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: And you know what? I think she's got a point there!
